findings.reason: F0003:S1:T29 identifies plasma, SC dosing and as-reported PMB sulphate, but does not explicitly define the measured analyte or total versus unbound concentration basis. Salt-dose wording does not establish assay analyte identity.
findings.needed_material: Source-backed assay analyte and concentration-basis definitions, formulation details and any proposed conversion justification; preserve unknown fields until confirmed.

findings.reason: F0003:S1:T29:A586-A588 explicitly describes digitized group means and calibrated times. Point-specific n and numerical SD were not recovered. Time origin, actual sampling times, serial versus destructive sampling, animal identifiers and BLQ/LLOQ metadata are NOT_FOUND on this page. The source does not establish individual trajectories.
findings.needed_material: Confirm applicable time origin, sampling design, assay limits and summary metadata from authorized source evidence. Retain calibrated times and group-summary status; leave modeling sufficiency to the animal PK module.
